styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Space Center, museums and the historic port.

styles.label: Family
styles.blurb: Space Center, zoo, parks and hands-on museums.

stays.why: Walkable core near the theater district, sports arenas and the rail line; good base without a car.
Quiet, leafy and next to the big museums, Hermann Park and the zoo; easy rail to downtown.
Mall shopping, many restaurants and hotels; handy if you plan to drive or shop.
Bars, cafés and galleries; central for nightlife and close to the Museum District.

food: Try Texas barbecue: brisket and ribs by the pound. Popular spots get long lines; go early or off-peak.
Tex-Mex is the local staple: breakfast tacos, fajitas and queso. Expect $8–15 for a plate.
Look for Viet-Cajun crawfish in season (roughly spring). Prices vary by market; check on the day.
Montrose and the Heights have dense clusters of cafés and casual restaurants; walk and pick one.
Tipping is expected: about 15–20% at sit-down restaurants.
more_time: Add a beach day at Galveston, about an hour's drive southeast; check traffic and the weather first.
Museum lovers can spend a half day at the Museum of Fine Arts and the nearby Hermann Park.
Baseball or basketball fans: check the Astros and Rockets home schedules before booking.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Space Center, the Museum District and a proper barbecue and Tex-Mex run; add a night for Galveston or nightlife.

month_notes: Cool and mild, highs near 17°C; a light jacket helps. About 11 rain days.
Slightly warmer, highs near 19°C; still comfortable for walking. About 12 rain days.
Pleasant, highs near 23°C; spring flowers and busy weekends. About 14 rain days.
Warm, highs near 25°C; good outdoor weather before the heat. About 14 rain days.
Getting hot and humid, highs near 29°C; plan midday indoors. About 17 rain days.
Hot, highs near 32°C; drink water and use AC breaks. About 16 rain days.
Peak heat, highs near 33°C; go out early or after sunset. About 16 rain days.
Still very hot, highs near 33°C; museums and malls are good escapes. About 17 rain days.
Hot but easing, highs near 31°C; watch for heavy downpours. About 14 rain days.
Comfort returns, highs near 27°C; great month for parks and patios. About 10 rain days.
Mild and pleasant, highs near 22°C; ideal for walking and outdoor sights. About 10 rain days.
Cool, highs near 19°C; pack a layer for evenings. About 12 rain days.

climate_guide.summary: Subtropical and humid: long hot summers, mild winters, and rain spread through the year with a wetter spring.

items.title: Best time: October to April
items.text: Highs run about 17–27°C. Comfortable for walking, parks and the Space Center.

items.title: Summer is hot and humid (June to September)
items.text: Highs near 32–33°C with muggy air. Do outdoor sights early morning; rest indoors midday.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 10–17 rain days each month, wettest in spring. Carry a small umbrella and check the forecast.

items.title: Heavy downpours possible
items.text: Storms can be intense and brief. Streets may flood; wait it out rather than driving through water.

items.title: Humidity is high
items.text: Expect sticky evenings in summer. Light, breathable clothes help; indoor AC is strong.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light layers, a rain jacket or umbrella, sunscreen and a hat; a light sweater for cool winter nights and cold AC.

transit.best: Rent a car or use ride apps; the rail and buses help downtown but the city is spread out.

modes.text: METRORail covers about 37 km on the Red, Green and Purple lines. Handy for downtown and the Museum District.
METRO buses fill the gaps; fare is about $1.25 each way. Pay with a METRO Q Card or day pass for free transfers within 3 hours.
Uber and Lyft are widely used; Empower is a local lower-cost option. Good for airport and late-night trips.
Driving is easiest but rush hour runs roughly 7-9AM and 4-6:30PM. Plan around it.
Downtown is walkable; elsewhere sidewalks are patchy and heat is fierce. Use rides for longer hops.
